days6To15.title: UK Outlook for Monday 23 Nov 2026 to Wednesday 2 Dec 2026
days6To15.text: Bands of rain will move in from the Atlantic at times, making erratic and uncertain eastward progress across the UK. These systems may also bring occasional strong winds.
